title: observability-token-kv-logging-dashboard-alert-tuning
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: improve observability for token-level KV/cache operations and reduce noisy alerts. Customers have reported spikes in KV miss rates and cost attribution noise (see SUP-714). This PR adds structured token-KV logging, enhances existing dashboards to show token-level KV hit/miss breakdowns, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce false positives while surfacing real regressions.

Summary of changes:
- Add structured logs for KV cache events at token-level (hit/miss/evict/insert) with stable field names and sampling controls.
- Emit lightweight aggregated metrics from the runtime for token-level KV hit-rate, miss-rate, average KV lookup latency, and eviction rate.
- Dashboard updates: new Token-KV Overview dashboard + per-model token-cost/latency breakdown panel.
- Alert tuning: adjust burn-rate and anomaly detection windows for KV miss-rate alerts, introduce a multi-window alert to reduce noise from short spikes.
- Add config flags (runtime config + env) to control logging sampling and metric cardinality for Dedicated/Private customers.

Checklist:
- [x] Add structured log schema and serializers (golang runtime).
- [x] Export new Prometheus metrics and map to Datadog metrics/queries.
- [x] Grafana/Datadog dashboard JSON and docs updates.
- [x] Alert rule updates and runbook changes.
- [x] Integration tests for metrics emission and log schema validation.
- [x] Backwards-compatible toggles and migration notes.

Commits summary: 7 commits (squashed on merge) - see commits list. High-level: schema and serializer, metrics exporter, dashboard JSON, alert rules, docs, tests, sampling config.

Changed areas (high-level):
- runtime/kv/logging.go: new structured log types and serializer (token_id, model, shard_id, event, latency_ms, cache_key_prefix).
- runtime/kv/metrics_exporter.go: incremental counters/histograms and a light aggregator that exports to Prometheus.
- observability/dashboards/token_kv_overview.json: new dashboard JSON for Datadog/Grafana.
- observability/alerts/kv_miss_rate.rules: tuned alert definitions with multi-window logic.
- infra/config/defaults.yaml: new sampling defaults and cardinality caps.
- docs/observability/token-kv-observability.md: docs and runbook for on-call.
- tests/integration/kv_metrics_test.go: integration tests for metric emission.

Migration notes: default sampling is conservative (0.1%) for high-volume tenants; Dedicated/private customers can increase sampling via runtime config. New metric names follow our naming conventions (redwood.kv.token.hit_rate, redwood.kv.token.miss_rate, redwood.kv.token.lookup_latency_ms) to keep dashboards compatible with existing dashboards.

Dashboard links (internal):
- Datadog token-KV overview: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/redwood-token-kv-overview
- Grafana (internal): https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/token-kv-overview

Testing: local unit tests + integration job ran in CI. Integration showed stable emission under a synthetic workload (10k req/s) with sampling. Load impact measured <2% CPU increase on serving runtime in our perf-canary.

Release notes: see release_notes field.

Merge outcome: after two approvals and CI green (one transient failure retried), changes were squashed and merged into main.

release_notes: - Add token-level KV logging (structured) - Export token-level KV metrics: hit_rate, miss_rate, lookup_latency_ms - New Token-KV Overview dashboard with token-cost/latency panels - Alert tuning: multi-window KV miss-rate alert to reduce false positives - Config flags to control logging sampling and cardinality caps
